name: Ferienhaus Wasserfallhütte
beschreibung:
Romantically set in nature near Kufstein, the rustic Wasserfallhuette offers an extraordinary mountain retreat for families and independent travellers. Enclosed by forest and mountain streams, guests revel in absolute privacy.

The location is ideal for alpine hikes into the Kaiser range, rock climbing, or peaceful unwinding, while the cultural highlights of Kufstein fortress remain close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Wasserfallhuette near Kufstein provides rustic alpine hut romance in total seclusion by a rushing mountain stream.
